properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 12:58PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 1258 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of showers
extending from 12 miles northeast of Boyero to 17 miles southwest of
Kutch, or extending from 19 miles south of Flagler to 43 miles
southwest of Limon, moving southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Karval, Punkin Center, Forder, Kutch and Boyero.
